meta.title: K-Bap — read any Korean menu
meta.description: Point your camera at a Korean menu. K-Bap translates every dish and marks the ones containing ingredients you listed as off-limits.
hero.sub: Snap a Korean menu. The dishes you should skip come back marked.
hero.shotAlt: The K-Bap app showing Korean dishes labelled Safe or Avoid, with a scan button
footer.disclaimer: Ingredient information is a guide, not medical advice.
